subject: Limited Time Offer: 20% Off All Summer Styles!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce a special promotion on all our summer styles! For a limited time only, enjoy a 20% discount on our latest collection of dresses, swimwear, and accessories. Whether you're planning a beach vacation or simply want to update your wardrobe, now is the perfect time to shop. Hurry, this offer ends soon! Visit our website or stop by our store to explore the latest trends. Don't miss out on this fantastic deal! Warm regards, The Fashion House Team
